evidence: The reporter says 0.100.2 stable on Windows 11 does not prompt for 0.101.x after Check for updates.
A second reporter says it occurred on two devices, manually upgraded one to 0.101.2362.0, and kept the other for reproduction.
The thread includes a screenshot and a PowerToysReport_2026-10-09-18-21-36.zip; contents were not inspected.
No issue-linked fix PR was found.
judgment.rationale: The issue gives a concrete 0.100.2 stable update-check scenario and discussion reports the same behavior on two devices. One was manually updated while the second was retained for reproduction; the thread includes a screenshot and a PowerToys report ZIP. The exact update-check result remains unknown, so use a maintainer reproduction rather than repeating a request for the supplied ZIP.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce Check for updates on the retained 0.100.2 device and trace the stable release result through Settings.

fix_assessment.rationale: An updater defect is plausible, but public comments and attachment links do not identify whether release discovery, network response, state propagation, policy, or notification caused the missing prompt.

proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: the stable updater may fail to recognize or surface a newer release for the reported 0.100.2 installation; the report does not establish whether lookup, version comparison, or UI notification failed.

confidence.rationale: Multiple reports make the symptom credible, but no inspected evidence identifies which updater or notification branch failed.

proposed_fixes.title: Trace stable update detection and status propagation
verification: With a newer stable release available, verify Check for updates reports it when the release response succeeds.
Verify network failure, policy-disabled notification, and genuinely up-to-date results remain distinct.
plan: Reproduce Check for updates on the retained 0.100.2 device and record the exact Settings result.
Trace the release response, parsed version comparison, runner update state, and notification/policy state; distinguish network errors from up-to-date.
Change only the branch shown to be wrong and add focused coverage for the reproduced outcome.

issue_context.analysis: The reporter already supplied new evidence, so repeating the old request for a ZIP would be stale. A maintainer reproduction on the retained device can correlate release response with the visible update state and identify whether a code fix is justified.
inferences: Stable-release detection or UI-state propagation is possible, but network failure, policy, or notification behavior could produce the same symptom.
The attached archive may help, but its contents have not been interpreted.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue and all three comments, including screenshot and ZIP links.
Confirmed the issue remains open and no matching fix PR is present.
Retained the earlier focused review of release lookup, version comparison, and update-state handoff as a hypothesis, not confirmed root cause.
issue_context.summary: Multiple users report that 0.100.2 stable does not prompt for 0.101.x; a screenshot and diagnostic ZIP are linked, but the exact update-check result is undetermined.
known_information: The issue reports 0.100.2 stable installed by executable on Windows 11 Pro and no prompt after Check for updates.
A reporter attached a screenshot on October 7 and on October 10 reported the same on two devices; one was manually updated and the other retained for reproduction.
A PowerToysReport ZIP is attached to the October 10 comment; its contents were not inspected.
There are no assignees and no issue-linked fix PR.

actions.label: Approve focused updater investigation
actions.note: Low-confidence investigation proposal, not a completed implementation design.

steps: Open Settings > General > Updates and select Check for updates.
Record the exact visible status and whether an update prompt appears.
Correlate with stable-release response, parsed version comparison, runner update state, and notification/policy state.
If available, compare with the second affected device after its manual update to 0.101.2362.
reproduce.module: PowerToys updater and Settings > General > Updates
prerequisites: Use the retained device described in the issue or an equivalent 0.100.2 stable installation.
Ensure network access and record whether update notifications/downloads are policy-managed.
reproduce.expected_result: When a newer stable release is returned successfully, Settings should show it as available; up-to-date, network failure, and suppressed notification remain distinguishable.
